events.title: Celebrate Juneteenth at NAAM
events.loc: Northwest African American Museum , 2300 S. Massachusetts St., Seattle
events.desc: Commemorate Juneteenth and enjoy a day at a fantastic museum, where there will be hands-on family activities, live performances, work from local artists and more. There will even be a World Cup watch party and sports activities.

events.title: Edmonds Arts Festival
events.loc: Frances Anderson Center , 700 Main St., Edmonds
events.desc: Still on the hunt for a perfect Father’s Day gift ? Take Dad to pick his gift out from the incredible art vendors at this family-favorite festival. You can even let the kids make the gift themselves in the children’s art activity area. Plus, there will be live entertainment, art exhibitions and a selection of delicious fair food.

events.title: Summer Splash: Festival of Fun
events.cost: $19.95 for online tickets or free with membership
events.loc: Hands On Children’s Museum , 414 Jefferson St. N.E., Olympia
events.desc: Summer kicks off at one of our favorite children’s museums this weekend with fort building and World Cup mini golf on Friday, an instrument petting zoo on Saturday, and special activities all weekend (and summer) long. There’s plenty to explore inside and out at this museum — plan for a full day!

events.title: Kickin’ It Federal Way
events.loc: Federal Way Performing Arts and Event Center , 31510 Pete von Reichbauer Way S., Federal Way
events.desc: Ready for more World Cup action? Watch the matches on the big screen, cheer on your favorite team, listen to live music and play games during this incredible three-day festival. There will also be food vendors, soccer clinics and more family fun.

events.title: Parke Diem
events.loc: Volunteer Park Amphitheater , 1139-1157 Volunteer Park Rd., Seattle
events.desc: It’s the longest-running free park party, and it’s at one of my very favorite parks. Local and regional music acts will be featured at this electronic music fest, along with live art, food and craft vendors. Play lawn games, grab lunch from a food truck and enjoy the vibes. There is so much to enjoy at Volunteer Park — from the balmy conservatory to the thrilling playground — that you can reall…

events.title: The Issaquah Library Is Turning 25
events.loc: Issaquah Library , 10 W. Sunset Way, Issaquah
events.desc: It’s a full-day extravaganza for the Issaquah Library’s 25th birthday! Kick things off with the Zaniac’s awesome comedy show, followed by a meet and greet with Pikachu. There will be refreshments and a fascinating look at the library’s history (and its origins as a barbershop).

events.title: Fremont Fair and Solstice Parade
events.loc: Fremont Neighborhood , Phinney Avenue North and North 35th Street, Seattle
events.desc: Welcome summer with an epic parade filled with giant puppets, stilt walkers and unique floats (and yes, more than a few naked cyclists). There will also be an eclectic craft market with specialty goods, artwork and apparel. Plus, gourmet food trucks will be serving up tasty bites. Make a day of it!

events.title: Fenders on Front Street
events.loc: Historic Shell Station & Downtown Issaquah , 232 Front St. N., Issaquah
events.desc: Surprise Dad (and Grandpa!) with a stroll through the historic downtown district of Issaquah, where classic rides will be on display. Then duck into a local diner for an iconic Father’s Day meal.

events.title: The Seattle Glow
events.loc: Seattle Center’s Fisher Pavilion , 305 Harrison St., Seattle
events.desc: Seattle Center is the place to be this weekend! Catch World Cup matches in the Armory, romp around the Artists at Play playground and then wrap up the day with this grand finale. There will be 100-foot-tall hot air balloons tethered to the ground, glowing against the night sky. It makes for incredible photos. events.title: Golden: A K-Pop Kids Party!
events.desc: Rarely a day goes by in my house without someone singing “Golden” from “K-Pop Demon Hunters.” So I know we can’t miss this epic party featuring K-pop songs. Dress in your best costumes and get ready to dance.
